description: Semantic Ground Truth — consolidated root manifest (2026-10-24). One manifest for all builds of all three bundles. Waves are '<build>-<n>'. Builds 1-3 are archived history ("archived": true; build 1 = app bundle sessions app-01..app-20, frozen copy docs/plans/manifests/build-1_app.json; build 2 = root sessions 01-15, PR #6, docs/plans/manifests/build-2_root.json; build 3 = brand + gaps sessions 16-24, PR #7 / run 745271774924215, docs/plans/manifests/build-3_brand_gaps.json). Build 4 (waves 4-0..4-9, sessions 25-41) is active: skip tracking + user settings, steward triage APIs, feedback pipeline as a Genie Code task, operations dashboard, MCP App review card, contract tests for every route and tool, Slack MCP and UI research, Figma Make brief. Run build 4 with run-now only=<w4-* task keys> until genie-build-waves skips archived waves. See docs/plans/INDEX.md.
